title: Example 136: a window start aligned by masking opens a window per request unless the window is a power of two
description: Regression proof (B9) by the tool's own checker (--engine native) of Crosscut's Window#counted rewritten to align the window's start by nowNanos & -windowNanos instead of nowNanos - nowNanos % windowNanos. Expected: violation, witness counted(this=Window[startNanos=0, count=0], nowNanos=1, windowNanos=3), before Window[0, 1], after Window[1, 1], found in 0.2 s searching inputs in [0:20]. JBMC finds the same witness in 0.2 s.

resources.notes: the last run used a stale jvmcontract; measured by the submitting sessions in seconds at under 200 MiB, except 142 at bound 8, 7 s
